g.text: Title: Reference selection and BIAS drive network

g.desc: Title: Reference selection and BIAS drive network

g.text: Sheet: /Reference selection and BIAS drive network/

g.desc: Sheet: /Reference selection and BIAS drive network/

g.text: Multiple selected REF branches sum leakage and provide parallel fault-current paths; evaluate as one system.

g.desc: Multiple selected REF branches sum leakage and provide parallel fault-current paths; evaluate as one system.

g.text: Do not inject sustained overvoltage or connect a person. RB1/RB2 need pulse/voltage-rated parts. AVDD back-power not resolved.

g.desc: Do not inject sustained overvoltage or connect a person. RB1/RB2 need pulse/voltage-rated parts. AVDD back-power not resolved.

g.text: FIRMWARE: BIASREF pin is tied to AVSS. Set BIASREF_INT=1 in the same CONFIG3 write that sets PD_BIAS=1. Monitor BIAS_STAT.

g.desc: FIRMWARE: BIASREF pin is tied to AVSS. Set BIASREF_INT=1 in the same CONFIG3 write that sets PD_BIAS=1. Monitor BIAS_STAT.

g.text: Zf = 1M || (100k + 10n). Replaces TI example 1M || 1.5n: model phase margin 14 deg nominal -> 84 deg; >=47 deg over sweep.

g.desc: Zf = 1M || (100k + 10n). Replaces TI example 1M || 1.5n: model phase margin 14 deg nominal -> 84 deg; >=47 deg over sweep.

g.text: REF is an electrode, not ADC VREF and not GND. Unselected negative electrodes are disconnected by JP.

g.desc: REF is an electrode, not ADC VREF and not GND. Unselected negative electrodes are disconnected by JP.

g.text: REF_RAW feeds pin 3 of JP1-JP8. Each selected branch has its own 94k / clamp / 4.7k input path.

g.desc: REF_RAW feeds pin 3 of JP1-JP8. Each selected branch has its own 94k / clamp / 4.7k input path.

g.text: C5 REFERENCE / BIAS / BENCH ONLY - STEP 8 COMPENSATED BIAS LOOP
